stop_rule: Twenty fixed regression conditions; preserve all failures and complete the cohort without gain, pause, threshold, initial-state or motor changes. Four successful pilot cases are reused, not repeated. Do not extend to fresh disturbances or export a promoted recovery replay unless all 20 pass and are audited.
